access_token = access['access_token']
playlist_id = 143
pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, access_token=access_token)
song_ids = [s.get('id') for s in pl.get('songs', [])]
print('playlist songs:', len(song_ids), song_ids)
# Fetch play_count for each song
song_stats = []
for sid in song_ids:
    s = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    song_stats.append({'song_id': sid, 'title': s.get('title'), 'play_count': s.get('play_count')})
print('song stats:')
for st in sorted(song_stats, key=lambda x: (-x['play_count'], x['song_id'])):
    print(st)
# Determine max
max_play = max(st['play_count'] for st in song_stats)
max_songs = [st for st in song_stats if st['play_count']==max_play]
print('max_play_count:', max_play)
print('max_songs:', max_songs)
# If multiple, choose first by lowest song_id
chosen = sorted(max_songs, key=lambda x: x['song_id'])[0]
print('chosen:', chosen)
chosen_song_id = chosen['song_id']
# Play it
play_resp = apis.spotify.play_music(access_token=access_token, song_id=chosen_song_id)
print('play_resp:', play_resp)
